_comment: Country-specific display configuration for Panama. Same shape as mongolia-country-config.json. Document taxonomy and provenance strings drive the dashboard without any code changes.
_documentTypesComment: Panama's source documents. NP + ENR were carried over from the original Apr 2026 xlsx; HR, PEG, PNSH, PENCYT, PIOTA, PNRF replaced IRMF + SPGCF on 11 May 2026 per Lea's 8 May feedback (data_panama_5May26.xlsx). Short labels come verbatim from the Doc column. Colors chosen from the UNDP-compatible Tailwind palette: avoided red (#dc2626 political sensitivity per CLAUDE.md), the BTR reserved #7c3aed, and the OTHER reserved #78716c. Colors are mutually distinguishable under deuteranopia/protanopia simulation. NP (Nature Pledge) is the anchor / national development plan; BTR is added at runtime via the reserved-token offset so it sorts last automatically.
_defaultHiddenDocTypesComment: Documents hidden by default EVERYWHERE (the briefing analytical views AND the Explore workbench, section 08), shipped to the browser and toggleable. ENR (Estrategia Nacional REDD+) is a ~206-target REDD+ strategy, roughly half the corpus, that a reviewer flagged as not a policy document and that skews every visual; the country office confirmed it is never needed on the default views. Distinct from excludedDocTypes (hard strip) and from secondaryDocTypes (hidden in the briefing only, still shown in Explore).
_secondaryDocTypesComment: Second-tier policy documents per the country office + regional office (July 2026). Hidden by default in the briefing analytical views (the coherence wheel on every slide, the doc-pairs matrix, section counts) so the four strategic documents (NP, PEG, PENCYT, PNSH) lead every view, but one click away via the document filter / wheel legend, and shown in full in the Explore workbench (section 08). The briefing seeds its hidden set from defaultHiddenDocTypes + secondaryDocTypes; Explore seeds from defaultHiddenDocTypes only, so it still shows these three (ENR stays hidden there). NOTE: the combined briefing default (ENR+HR+PIOTA+PNRF hidden) is not a precomputed synthesis state, so the corpus-themes and sector AI-synthesis prose fall back to full-corpus text with a caveat (or on-demand regeneration) until the synthesis layer is re-run; figures, the wheel, the matrix and doc-pair storylines stay exact regardless.
_docClassComment: Machine-readable document classification (docClass) and national-hierarchy level (docTier) consumed by src/lib/doc-taxonomy. Added Aug 2026 in response to the Panama focal-group report (23 Jul 2026), which found that showing documents of different types and hierarchies without differentiation led readers to misread the relationships between them. THE VOCABULARY IS PROJECT-DEFINED (see DOC_CLASSES in src/lib/doc-taxonomy); EACH ASSIGNMENT TRACES TO THE DOCUMENT'S OWN SELF-DESCRIPTION, already recorded in docKind / objective below: NP calls itself a pledge unifying Panama's climate, biodiversity and land-degradation commitments in a single framework, so it is the commitment the other instruments answer to (tier 1). PEG is the whole-of-government Plan Estrategico de Gobierno for the 2025-2029 administration (tier 2). PENCYT and PNSH are national plans each scoped to one theme, science-technology-innovation and water security (sector_plan, tier 3). ENR calls itself a strategy defining measures to reduce deforestation across 33 priority basins (sector_strategy, tier 3). HR states that it operationalises the Nature Pledge, so it is downstream of NP (roadmap, tier 4). PNRF is a national programme with its own delivery target of 50k hectares in five years (programme, tier 4). PIOTA is a territorial and environmental planning instrument for the Panama Canal watershed, i.e. subnational in scope (territorial_instrument, tier 4). BTR is not listed: reporting / tier 5 comes from the reserved-token defaults in doc-taxonomy. CNR is excluded from the product. NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE COUNTRY OFFICE - confirm before this ships.
_documentMetaComment: Reference metadata (docKind / published / author / url / objective) for the doc-focus panel. URLs verified to resolve (HTTP 200/206) on 2026-06-30 against official domains; large PDF bodies were not all text-extracted, so 'match' rests on official domain + exact filename. Notes: NP is also mirrored on transparencia-climatica.miambiente.gob.pa; the PEG url is the Gaceta Oficial No. 30186-b (27 Dec 2024) that publishes the plan; PNSH uses the water-security PDF the CO originally mis-slotted under PNRF (confirmed = Plan Nacional de Seguridad Hidrica, NOT forest restoration). HR (Hoja de Ruta) has no standalone public PDF (it lives inside the Nature Pledge document + the online module), so no url; its year is the roadmap presentation (news-sourced). PNRF has no direct official PDF; the url is MiAMBIENTE's official FlipHTML5 flipbook of the full programme (the Gaceta No. 29294-A adoption decree is also at https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/pan204044.pdf). Objectives for NP/ENR are concise factual summaries from the official MiAMBIENTE platform/launch pages; the PNRF objective is near-verbatim from the MiAMBIENTE press release. CNR is excluded from the product.
